## Results

**Study:** `ens-proxy-smoke` — LHS design, n=8, seed_root=11, 3 uncertain inputs (tm, wi, k[3])
**Failed members: 0** (8/8 succeeded)

### P10 / P50 / P90 of oil rate at **60 days** (m³/day, production positive)

| Well | P10 | P50 | P90 |
|------|-----|-----|-----|
| **P1** | 199.2  [CI: 188.0 – 368.7] | 390.1  [CI: 272.6 – 499.4] | 657.8  [CI: 401.2 – 806.7] |
| **P2** | 411.3  [CI: 394.5 – 604.3] | 652.9  [CI: 491.9 – 886.3] | 1076.4  [CI: 701.0 – 1175.8] |
| **P3** | 232.5  [CI: 205.3 – 349.6] | 372.6  [CI: 284.1 – 530.1] | 621.2  [CI: 411.1 – 700.9] |

Bootstrap 90% confidence intervals (2000 resamples). With only n=8 members the intervals are wide — all P10/P90 differences are **not resolved** at this sample size.

### Full table (all report times)

| Well | t (d) | P10 | P50 | P90 |
|------|-------|-----|-----|-----|
| P1 | 20 | 270.5 | 422.6 | 660.9 |
| P1 | 40 | 200.4 | 390.7 | 654.2 |
| P1 | 60 | 199.2 | 390.1 | 657.8 |
| P2 | 20 | 433.4 | 665.5 | 1079.2 |
| P2 | 40 | 410.0 | 651.7 | 1073.9 |
| P2 | 60 | 411.3 | 652.9 | 1076.4 |
| P3 | 20 | 247.0 | 381.0 | 627.0 |
| P3 | 40 | 230.8 | 370.2 | 620.1 |
| P3 | 60 | 232.5 | 372.6 | 621.2 |

**Notes:** Rates are roughly stable from day 20 → 60 for all producers (BHP-controlled wells). P2 produces highest (~1.7× P1/P3 at P50). The P90/P10 ratio is ~3× for all three wells, reflecting the combined uncertainty across tm, wi, and the 3-component permeability field. Increase n to ≥ 32 before drawing quantitative conclusions.
